notes: 7 tests x 30 = 210, every item used once in tests (pools exactly 7x each count). Training: five topic sets 14701-14705 (Gefahrenlehre 49, Verhalten 42, Vorfahrt 28, Zeichen 35, Umwelt+Betrieb+Technik+Eignung 56), so the dashboard is 5 sets + 7 tests = 12 steps. passPct 93 = ceil(0.93 x 30) = 28 of 30 (at most two mistakes), Tigertest's target because point weighting (2 to 5 error points, max 10, two 5-pointers fail) is not modelled. Categories are the eight Sachgebiete of the official catalogue (FeV Anlage 7 Nr. 1.1); per-test weights are Tigertest's own.
